{{Quote|This old dog is no stranger to new tricks.|Gideon Argus|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set">{{SWIA|set=Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|text=Core Set}}</ref>}}
'''Gideon Argus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Well-trained in battlefield tactics, he possessed a fierce intellect and the sangfroid to command calmly in the heat of battle. Argus founded the legendary [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] unit [[Saber Team/Legends|Saber Team]].<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />
